construct_repairs.defect: CURRENT_ECHO key omitted the candidate's cross-session recurrence increment
construct_repairs.fresh_control_requirement: A NOT_SUITABLE redundancy case must state in the visible current text both the present proposition and the same prior recurrence/history proposition, so the past source adds no proposition at all. Same-day versus prior-day similarity is not sufficient.

construct_repairs.defect: A positive sister/call case did not bind the current event to the candidate event
construct_repairs.fresh_control_requirement: A SUITABLE event-specific case must visibly bind the same entity and event chain while withholding exactly one past-only proposition that permits a material response change. A merely similar event or unnamed relation is abstainable and cannot be keyed positive.

construct_repairs.defect: A reviewer treated asking whether an unresolved memory was relevant as Function
construct_repairs.fresh_control_requirement: At least one SEMANTIC_ABSTAIN control must make entity/event binding genuinely unresolved. Asking which candidate entity/event is meant, whether the memory is relevant, or permission to inspect it is explicitly meta-clarification and cannot be an allowed candidate response change.
